apis.detail: if true, this unit will look at whatever it is building
apis.description: 如果是真的，这个单元将查看它正在建造的任何东西

apis.name: allowLegStep
apis.detail: if true and this is a legged unit, this unit can walk over blocks.
apis.description: 如果为真，并且这是一个有腿的单位，那么这个单位可以走过街区。

apis.name: legPhysicsLayer
apis.detail: for legged units, setting this to false forces it to be on the ground physics layer.
apis.description: 对于腿式单元，将其设置为false会强制其位于地面物理层。

apis.name: hovering
apis.detail: if true, this unit cannot drown, and will not be affected by the floor under it.
apis.description: 如果是真的，这个单元不会淹死，也不会受到它下面地板的影响。

apis.name: omniMovement
apis.detail: if true, this unit can move in any direction regardless of rotation. if false, this unit can only move in the direction it is facing.
apis.description: 如果为真，则该单元可以在任何方向上移动，而与旋转无关。如果为false，则该单元只能朝着它所面对的方向移动。

apis.name: rotateMoveFirst
apis.detail: if true, the unit faces its moving direction before actually moving.
apis.description: 如果为真，则该单元在实际移动之前会面向其移动方向。

apis.name: healFlash
apis.detail: if true, this unit flashes when being healed
apis.description: 如果为真，则此单元在愈合时闪烁

apis.name: canHeal
apis.detail: whether the unit can heal blocks. Initialized in init()
apis.description: 该装置是否可以治愈堵塞。在init（）中初始化

apis.name: singleTarget
apis.detail: if true, all weapons will attack the same target.
apis.description: 如果是真的，所有武器都会攻击同一个目标。

apis.name: forceMultiTarget
apis.detail: if true, this unit will be able to have multiple targets, even if it only has one mirrored weapon.
apis.description: 如果为真，该部队将能够拥有多个目标，即使它只有一个镜像武器。

apis.name: canAttack
apis.detail: if false, this unit has no weapons that can attack.
apis.description: 如果为假，则该部队没有可以攻击的武器。

apis.name: hidden
apis.detail: if true, this unit won't show up in the database or various other UIs.
apis.description: 如果为真，此单元将不会显示在数据库或其他各种UI中。

apis.name: internal
apis.detail: if true, this unit is for internal use only and does not have a sprite generated.
apis.description: 如果为true，则此单元仅供内部使用，不会生成精灵。

apis.name: bounded
apis.detail: If false, this unit is not pushed away from map edges.
apis.description: 如果为false，则此单元不会被推离贴图边缘。

apis.name: naval
apis.detail: if true, this unit is detected as naval - do NOT assign this manually! Initialized in init()
apis.description: 如果为真，则该单位被检测为海军单位——不要手动分配！在init（）中初始化

apis.name: autoFindTarget
apis.detail: if false, RTS AI controlled units do not automatically attack things while moving. This is automatically assigned.
apis.description: 如果为假，RTS AI控制的单元在移动时不会自动攻击物体。这是自动分配的。

apis.name: targetUnderBlocks
apis.detail: If false, 'under' blocks like conveyors are not targeted.
apis.description: 如果为false，则输送机等“下”块不会成为目标。

apis.name: alwaysShootWhenMoving
apis.detail: if true, this unit will always shoot while moving regardless of slowdown
apis.description: 如果为真，无论减速如何，该装置在移动时都会一直射击

apis.name: hoverable
apis.detail: whether this unit has a hover tooltip
apis.description: 此单元是否有悬停工具提示

apis.name: alwaysCreateOutline
apis.detail: if true, this modded unit always has a -outline region generated for its base. Normally, outlines are ignored if there are no top = false weapons.
apis.description: 如果为真，则此修改后的单元总是会为其底部生成一个轮廓区域。通常，如果没有顶部=假武器，轮廓会被忽略。

apis.name: squareShape
apis.detail: if true, this unit has a square shadow.
apis.description: 如果为真，则此单位有一个方形阴影。

apis.name: drawBuildBeam
apis.detail: if true, this unit will draw its building beam towards blocks.
apis.description: 如果为真，该单元将把建筑梁拉向砌块。

apis.name: drawMineBeam
apis.detail: if true, this unit will draw its mining beam towards blocks
apis.description: 如果为真，该单元将把其采矿梁拉向矿块

apis.name: drawCell
apis.detail: if false, the team indicator/cell is not drawn.
apis.description: 如果为false，则不绘制团队指示符/单元格。

apis.name: drawItems
apis.detail: if false, carried items are not drawn.
apis.description: 如果为false，则不提取携带的物品。

apis.name: drawShields
apis.detail: if false, the unit shield (usually seen in waves) is not drawn.
apis.description: 如果为假，则不会绘制单位屏蔽（通常在波浪中看到）。

apis.name: drawBody
apis.detail: if false, the unit body is not drawn.
apis.description: 如果为false，则不绘制单元体。

apis.name: drawMinimap
apis.detail: if false, the unit is not drawn on the minimap.
apis.description: 如果为false，则该单位不会绘制在小地图上。

apis.name: abilities
apis.detail: list of "abilities", which are various behaviors that update each frame
apis.description: “能力”列表，即更新每个帧的各种行为

apis.name: weapons
apis.detail: All weapons that this unit will shoot with.
apis.description: 这支部队将使用的所有武器。

apis.name: healColor
apis.detail: color that this unit flashes when getting healed (if healFlash is true)
apis.description: 此单元在愈合时闪烁的颜色（如果healFlash为真）

apis.name: lightColor
apis.detail: Color of light that this unit produces when lighting is enabled in the map.
apis.description: 在地图中启用照明时，此单元产生的光的颜色。

apis.name: shieldColor
apis.detail: override for unit shield colour.
apis.description: 机组屏蔽颜色的超控。

apis.name: deathSound
apis.detail: sound played when this unit explodes (*not* when it is shot down)
apis.description: 该装置爆炸时播放的声音（*不是*被击落时播放的）

apis.name: loopSound
apis.detail: sound played on loop when this unit is around.
apis.description: 当这个装置存在时，在循环中播放的声音。

apis.name: loopSoundVolume
apis.detail: volume of loop sound
apis.description: 环路声音的音量

apis.name: fallEffect
apis.detail: effect that this unit emits when falling
apis.description: 该装置坠落时发出的效果

apis.name: fallEngineEffect
apis.detail: effect created at engine when unit falls.
apis.description: 机组下降时在发动机上产生的效果。

apis.name: deathExplosionEffect
apis.detail: effect created when this unit dies
apis.description: 此单位死亡时产生的效果

apis.name: treadEffect
apis.detail: optional effect created when this tank moves
apis.description: 此坦克移动时创建的可选效果

apis.name: parts
apis.detail: extra (usually animated) visual parts
apis.description: 额外的（通常是动画）视觉部分

apis.name: useEngineElevation
apis.detail: if false, the thruster is always displayed at its normal size regardless of elevation
apis.description: 如果为假，则推进器始终以正常尺寸显示，而不管高度如何

apis.name: engineColor
apis.detail: override for all engine colors
apis.description: 覆盖所有发动机颜色

apis.name: engineColorInner
apis.detail: color for inner portions of engines
apis.description: 发动机内部的颜色

apis.name: trailLength
apis.detail: length of engine trail (if flying) or wave trail (if naval)
apis.description: 发动机尾迹（如果飞行）或波浪尾迹（如果海军）的长度

apis.name: trailColor
apis.detail: override for engine trail color
apis.description: 发动机痕迹颜色的覆盖

apis.name: pathCostId
apis.detail: ID for path cost, to be used in the control path finder. This is the value that actually matters; do not assign manually. Set in init().
apis.description: 用于控制路径查找器的路径成本ID。这才是真正重要的价值；不要手动分配。在init（）中设置。

apis.name: sample
apis.detail: A sample of the unit that this type creates. Do not modify!
apis.description: 此类型创建的单元示例。请勿修改！

apis.name: targetFlags
apis.detail: Flags to target based on priority. Null indicates that the closest target should be found. The closest enemy core is used as a fallback.
apis.description: 根据优先级标记目标。Null表示应找到最近的目标。最近的敌方核心被用作后备。

apis.name: allowChangeCommands
apis.detail: A value of false is used to hide command changing UI in unit factories.
apis.description: 值false用于隐藏单位工厂中的命令更改UI。

apis.name: commands
apis.detail: Commands available to this unit through RTS controls. An empty array means commands will be assigned based on unit capabilities in init().
apis.description: 通过RTS控制可用于此单元的命令。空数组表示将根据init（）中的单元功能分配命令。

apis.name: defaultCommand
apis.detail: Command to assign to this unit upon creation. Null indicates the first command in the array.
apis.description: 创建时分配给此单元的命令。Null表示数组中的第一个命令。

apis.name: stances
apis.detail: Stances this unit can have.  An empty array means stances will be assigned based on unit capabilities in init().
apis.description: 这个单位可以有姿势。空数组意味着将根据init（）中的单位能力分配姿态。

apis.name: outlineColor
apis.detail: color for outline generated around sprites
apis.description: 围绕精灵生成的轮廓颜色

apis.name: outlineRadius
apis.detail: thickness for sprite outline
apis.description: 精灵轮廓的厚度

apis.name: outlines
apis.detail: if false, no sprite outlines are generated
apis.description: 如果为false，则不会生成精灵轮廓

apis.name: itemCapacity
apis.detail: amount of items this unit can carry; <0 to determine based on hitSize.
apis.description: 该单元可携带的物品数量<0根据hitSize确定。

apis.name: ammoCapacity
apis.detail: amount of ammo this unit can hold (if the rule is enabled); <0 to determine based on weapon fire rate.
apis.description: 该单位可以容纳的弹药量（如果规则启用）<0根据武器射速确定。

apis.name: ammoType
apis.detail: ammo this unit uses, if that system is enabled.
apis.description: 如果该系统启用，则该部队使用的弹药。

apis.name: mineTier
apis.detail: max hardness of ore that this unit can mine (<0 to disable)
apis.description: 该装置可以开采的最大矿石硬度（<0表示禁用）

apis.name: mineSpeed
apis.detail: mining speed in weird arbitrary units
apis.description: 奇异任意单位下的挖掘速度

apis.name: mineWalls
apis.detail: whether this unit can mine ores from floors/walls, respectively
apis.description: 该装置是否可以分别从地板/墙壁上开采矿石

apis.name: mineFloor
apis.detail: whether this unit can mine ores from floors/walls, respectively
apis.description: 该装置是否可以分别从地板/墙壁上开采矿石

apis.name: mineHardnessScaling
apis.detail: if true, harder materials will take longer to mine
apis.description: 如果属实，开采较硬的材料需要更长的时间

apis.name: mineSound
apis.detail: continuous sound emitted when mining.
apis.description: 采矿时发出的连续声音。

apis.name: mineSoundVolume
apis.detail: volume of mining sound.
apis.description: 采矿声音的音量。

apis.name: mineItems
apis.detail: Target items to mine. Used in MinerAI
apis.description: 目标项目要挖掘。用于MinerAI

apis.name: legCount
apis.detail: number of legs this unit has (must have the correct type to function!)
apis.description: 此装置的支腿数量（必须具有正确的类型才能运行！）

apis.name: legGroupSize
apis.detail: size of groups in which legs move. for example, insects (6 legs) usually move legs in groups of 3.
apis.description: 腿移动的群体大小。例如昆虫（6条腿）通常以3条腿为一组移动腿。

apis.name: legLength
apis.detail: total length of a leg (both segments)
apis.description: 腿的总长度（两段）

apis.name: legSpeed
apis.detail: how fast individual legs move towards their destination (non-linear)
apis.description: 每条腿向目的地移动的速度（非线性）

apis.name: legForwardScl
apis.detail: scale for how far in front (relative to unit velocity) legs try to place themselves; if legs lag behind a unit, increase this number
apis.description: 腿试图放在前方（相对于单位速度）的距离；如果腿落后于一个单位，则增加这个数字

apis.name: legBaseOffset
apis.detail: leg offset from the center of the unit
apis.description: 支腿偏离装置中心

apis.name: legMoveSpace
apis.detail: scaling for space between leg movements
apis.description: 腿部动作之间的空间缩放

apis.name: legExtension
apis.detail: for legs without "joints", this is how much the second leg sprite is moved "back" by, so it covers the joint region (it's hard to explain without an image)
apis.description: 对于没有“关节”的腿，这是第二条腿精灵“向后”移动的量，因此它覆盖了关节区域（没有图像很难解释）

apis.name: legPairOffset
apis.detail: Higher values of this field make groups of legs move less in-sync with each other.
apis.description: 该字段的值越高，各组腿的运动同步性越低。

apis.name: legLengthScl
apis.detail: scaling for how far away legs *try* to be from the body (not their actual length); e.g. if set to 0.5, legs will appear somewhat folded
apis.description: 缩放腿与身体的距离（而不是实际长度）；例如，如果设置为0.5，腿会显得有些折叠

apis.name: legStraightLength
apis.detail: if legStraightness > 0, this is the scale for how far away legs are from the body horizontally
apis.description: 如果腿直度>0，这是腿与身体水平距离的刻度

apis.name: legMaxLength
apis.detail: maximum length of an individual leg as fraction of real length
apis.description: 单个腿的最大长度占实际长度的比例

apis.name: legMinLength
apis.detail: minimum length of an individual leg as fraction of real length
apis.description: 单个腿的最小长度占实际长度的比例

apis.name: legSplashDamage
apis.detail: splash damage dealt when a leg touches the ground
apis.description: 腿触地时造成的飞溅伤害

apis.name: legSplashRange
apis.detail: splash damage radius of legs
apis.description: 腿部飞溅损伤半径

apis.name: baseLegStraightness
apis.detail: how straight the leg base/origin is (0 = circular, 1 = line)
apis.description: 腿底/原点有多直（0=圆形，1=直线）

apis.name: legStraightness
apis.detail: how straight the leg outward angles are (0 = circular, 1 = horizontal line)
apis.description: 腿向外的角度有多直（0=圆形，1=水平线）

apis.name: lockLegBase
apis.detail: If true, legs are locked to the base of the unit instead of being on an implicit rotating "mount".
apis.description: 如果为真，支腿将锁定在装置的底座上，而不是位于隐式旋转的“支架”上。

apis.name: legContinuousMove
apis.detail: If true, legs always try to move around even when the unit is not moving (leads to more natural behavior)
apis.description: 如果为真，即使设备没有移动，腿也总是试图四处移动（导致更自然的行为）

apis.name: flipBackLegs
apis.detail: TODO neither of these appear to do much
apis.description: TODO这两项似乎都没有多大作用

apis.name: flipLegSide
apis.detail: TODO neither of these appear to do much
apis.description: TODO这两项似乎都没有多大作用

apis.name: mechLandShake
apis.detail: screen shake amount for when this mech lands after boosting
apis.description: 该机甲在助推后着陆时的屏幕抖动量

apis.name: mechSideSway
apis.detail: parameters for mech swaying animation
apis.description: 机械摇摆动画参数

apis.name: mechFrontSway
apis.detail: parameters for mech swaying animation
apis.description: 机械摇摆动画参数

apis.name: mechStride
apis.detail: parameters for mech swaying animation
apis.description: 机械摇摆动画参数

apis.name: mechStepParticles
apis.detail: whether particles are created when this mech takes a step
apis.description: 当这个机械装置迈出一步时，是否会产生粒子

apis.name: mechLegColor
apis.detail: color that legs change to when moving, to simulate depth
apis.description: 腿在移动时改变的颜色，以模拟深度

apis.name: treadFrames
apis.detail: number of frames of movement in a tread
apis.description: 胎面运动帧数

apis.name: treadPullOffset
apis.detail: how much of a top part of a tread sprite is "cut off" relative to the pattern; this is corrected for
apis.description: 胎面精灵的顶部相对于图案被“切掉”了多少；这已得到纠正

apis.name: segments
apis.detail: number of independent segments
apis.description: 独立分段数

apis.name: segmentMag
apis.detail: magnitude of sine offset between segments
apis.description: 段之间的正弦偏移量

apis.name: segmentScl
apis.detail: scale of sine offset between segments
apis.description: 段间正弦偏移的比例

apis.name: segmentPhase
apis.detail: index multiplier of sine offset between segments
apis.description: 段间正弦偏移的索引乘数

apis.name: segmentRotSpeed
apis.detail: how fast each segment moves towards the next one
apis.description: 每个分段向下一个分段移动的速度有多快

apis.name: segmentMaxRot
apis.detail: maximum difference between segment angles
apis.description: 分段角度之间的最大差异

apis.name: crawlSlowdown
apis.detail: speed multiplier this unit will have when crawlSlowdownFrac is met.
apis.description: 当达到爬行减速压裂时，该装置将具有速度倍数。

apis.name: crushDamage
apis.detail: damage dealt to blocks under this tank/crawler every frame.
apis.description: 每架坦克/履带下的木块都受到了损坏。

apis.name: crawlSlowdownFrac
apis.detail: the fraction of solids under this block necessary for it to reach crawlSlowdown.
apis.description: 该块下达到爬行减速所需的固体分数。

apis.name: lifetime
apis.detail: lifetime of this missile.
apis.description: 这枚导弹的寿命。

apis.name: homingDelay
apis.detail: ticks that must pass before this missile starts homing.
apis.description: 在导弹开始归航之前必须经过的滴答声。

apis.name: name
apis.detail: displayed weapon region
apis.description: 显示武器区

apis.name: bullet
apis.detail: bullet shot
apis.description: 子弹射击

apis.name: ejectEffect
apis.detail: shell ejection effect
apis.description: 炮弹弹射效应

apis.name: display
apis.detail: whether weapon should appear in the stats of a unit with this weapon
apis.description: 武器是否应该出现在拥有该武器的单位的统计数据中

apis.name: useAmmo
apis.detail: whether to consume ammo when ammo is enabled in rules
apis.description: 规则中启用弹药时是否消耗弹药

apis.name: mirror
apis.detail: whether to create a flipped copy of this weapon upon initialization. default: true
apis.description: 是否在初始化时创建此武器的翻转副本。默认值：true

apis.name: flipSprite
apis.detail: whether to flip the weapon's sprite when rendering. internal use only - do not set!
apis.description: 渲染时是否翻转武器的精灵。仅供内部使用-不要设置！

apis.name: alternate
apis.detail: whether to shoot the weapons in different arms one after another, rather than all at once; only valid when mirror = true
apis.description: 是否要一个接一个地射击不同武器，而不是一次全部射击；仅当mirror=true时有效

apis.name: rotate
apis.detail: whether to rotate toward the target independently of unit
apis.description: 是否独立于单元朝向目标旋转

apis.name: showStatSprite
apis.detail: Whether to show the sprite of the weapon in the database.
apis.description: 是否在数据库中显示武器的精灵。

apis.name: baseRotation
apis.detail: rotation at which this weapon starts at. TODO buggy!
apis.description: 此武器开始旋转的角度。TODO越野车！

apis.name: top
apis.detail: whether to draw the outline on top.
apis.description: 是否在上面画轮廓。

apis.name: continuous
apis.detail: whether to hold the bullet in place while firing; it will still require reload.
apis.description: 射击时是否将子弹固定到位；它仍然需要重新加载。

apis.name: alwaysContinuous
apis.detail: whether this weapon uses continuous fire without reloading; implies continuous = true
apis.description: 这种武器是否在不重新装弹的情况下使用连续火力；意味着连续=真

apis.name: aimChangeSpeed
apis.detail: Speed at which the turret can change its bullet "aim" distance. This is only used for point laser bullets.
apis.description: 炮塔改变子弹“瞄准”距离的速度。这仅用于点激光子弹。

apis.name: controllable
apis.detail: whether this weapon can be aimed manually by players
apis.description: 玩家是否可以手动瞄准此武器

apis.name: aiControllable
apis.detail: whether this weapon can be automatically aimed by the unit
apis.description: 该武器能否被部队自动瞄准

apis.name: alwaysShooting
apis.detail: whether this weapon is always shooting, regardless of targets ore cone
apis.description: 这种武器是否总是射击，不管目标是矿石锥

apis.name: autoTarget
apis.detail: whether to automatically target relevant units in update(); only works when controllable = false.
apis.description: 是否在update（）中自动定位相关单元；仅在可控=假时有效。

apis.name: predictTarget
apis.detail: whether to perform target trajectory prediction
apis.description: 是否进行目标轨迹预测

apis.name: useAttackRange
apis.detail: if true, this weapon is used for attack range calculations
apis.description: 如果为真，则该武器用于计算攻击距离

apis.name: targetInterval
apis.detail: ticks to wait in-between targets
apis.description: 在目标之间等待的滴答声

apis.name: targetSwitchInterval
apis.detail: ticks to wait in-between targets
apis.description: 在目标之间等待的滴答声

apis.name: rotateSpeed
apis.detail: rotation speed of weapon when rotation is enabled, in degrees/t
apis.description: 启用旋转时武器的旋转速度，单位为度/t

apis.name: reload
apis.detail: weapon reload in frames
apis.description: 武器装弹

apis.name: inaccuracy
apis.detail: inaccuracy of degrees of each shot
apis.description: 每次射击的度数不准确

apis.name: shake
apis.detail: intensity and duration of each shot's screen shake
apis.description: 每个镜头屏幕抖动的强度和持续时间

apis.name: recoil
apis.detail: visual weapon knockback.
apis.description: 视觉武器击退。

apis.name: recoils
apis.detail: Number of additional counters for recoil.
apis.description: 反冲附加计数器的数量。

apis.name: recoilTime
